steps.en: Install on isolated Linux; set models and credentials
steps.zh: 在隔离 Linux 安装，配置模型与凭据

steps.en: Fetch pinned runners and task data, and create benchmark environments
steps.zh: 获取固定版本运行器与任务数据，创建基准环境

steps.en: After setup, block benchmark-answer access; run one task in one legal domain
steps.zh: 安装后阻断基准答案访问，再运行一个领域的一个任务

steps.en: Probe edits, compose a harness, and save deliverables and lessons
steps.zh: 试跑修改、合成配置，保存交付物与经验

steps.en: Judge and report using the same experiment settings
steps.zh: 用相同实验参数评分并生成报表

steps.en: Produce graded results for the adopted output
steps.zh: 产出已采纳交付物的评分结果

value.en: A task-adapted harness, deliverable, and separately graded result without editing model weights
value.zh: 不改模型权重，得到适配任务的配置、交付物和独立评分
